body.statement: For every \(\vartheta_n=(L_n,D_n)\in\Theta_n\) and every \(b\in\mathcal B_n\), \(\operatorname{rank}(L_{n,C_bP_b})=r\) implies \[L_{n,I_bQ_b}=L_{n,I_bP_b}L_{n,C_bP_b}^{\dagger}L_{n,C_bQ_b}.\] Hence the tuple-indexed missing-block mean is a functional of the observed mean under \(\mathbb Q_{\vartheta,n}\).
body.justification: The identity supplies the algebraic map used by the benchmark certificate and is not itself the novelty claim.
body.gap: Bai and Ng use tall-wide rotation for imputation but do not make this tuple-indexed block identity the basis of an honest nuclear ball.
body.consumer: The synchronized spectral certificate uses the identity to combine observed blocks while keeping the latent target attached to the experiment index.
